put.description: Sequence zero creates one owned operation; newer sequences replace its full joint target. Duplicate updates do not renew expiry. Acceptance does not mean the target was reached. Defaults: speed 0.1, TTL 0.5 seconds; maximum TTL 1 second. Unavailable on hardware until hold acceptance.
